title: Volume problem and restart
body:
I used the computer normally for about two weeks. During the second week, I started experiencing several issues. The volume would go down by itself without me touching any buttons, and the computer would also restart on its own.

A message would appear saying, “The computer ran into a problem and needs to restart.”

This happens about 2 or 3 times while I’m using the computer.

title: My New HP OMNI X
body:
Initial setup was fine however Regular messages advising " your device ran into a problem and needs to restart" have become very annoying, it is something that I have never experienced b4 with any other Windows computer. It seems the messages only started after I uninstalled Mcafee software and disabled a couple of other "bloat ware" non windows programs. I have run diagnostic program  sfc /scannow and it failed to find any problems. If this remains unresolved then the Omni might have to be returned for a refund.Any help appreciated.
Thanks PetrG.

title: VERY crisp screen!
body:
Love my new OmniX  'customized' HP laptop.  The colors are so vivid.  Glad I was able to customize up to a 2T, 32gb hard drive for all my travel photos. Wish I could have customized w/o the "flip" option with all my specs, but at least I got all what I wanted $$.  I wonder if I'll ever use the 'flip' option....  After I got mine, we customized the same Omni X for my husband with just a 1T storage.
Area for improvement? - Yes, make more laptop base models customizeable, like back in 2019, with my last laptop. :)
product_name: HP OmniBook X Flip 16" Touchscreen 2-in-1 Laptop -Eclipse Grey Aluminum (Intel Core Ultra 5 325/16GB RAM/1TB SSD)
